Gen.name: Genesis
Gen.author: Attributed to Moses
Gen.date: Composition spanning the second and first millennia BC, reaching its final form by the sixth century BC
Gen.audience: Israel in the wilderness and later in exile
Gen.summary: Origins of the world, humanity, covenant, and the family of Abraham.

Exo.name: Exodus
Exo.author: Attributed to Moses
Exo.date: Final form by the sixth century BC
Exo.summary: Deliverance from Egypt, the covenant at Sinai, and the tabernacle.

Lev.name: Leviticus
Lev.author: Attributed to Moses
Lev.date: Priestly material compiled by the sixth century BC
Lev.audience: Israel at Sinai, addressed to priests

Num.name: Numbers
Num.author: Attributed to Moses
Num.date: Final form by the sixth century BC
Num.place: Sinai, the wilderness, the plains of Moab
Num.summary: The wilderness journey and the faithfulness of God despite Israel's failure.

Deu.name: Deuteronomy
Deu.author: Attributed to Moses
Deu.date: Final form by the sixth century BC
Deu.audience: Israel on the edge of Canaan
Deu.summary: Covenant renewal and instruction for life in the land.

Jos.name: Joshua
Jos.author: Anonymous
Jos.date: Sixth century BC final form describing events around 1400 to 1200 BC
Jos.summary: Conquest and settlement of the land.

Jdg.name: Judges
Jdg.author: Anonymous
Jdg.date: Compiled by the sixth century BC
Jdg.summary: Cycles of apostasy, oppression, and deliverance.

Rut.name: Ruth
Rut.author: Anonymous
Rut.date: Setting in the period of the judges, written later
Rut.summary: Loyalty, redemption, and the ancestry of David.

1Sa.name: 1 Samuel
1Sa.author: Anonymous, incorporating earlier sources
1Sa.date: Final form by the sixth century BC
1Sa.audience: Israel at the founding of the monarchy
1Sa.summary: Samuel, Saul, and the rise of David.

2Sa.name: 2 Samuel
2Sa.author: Anonymous, incorporating earlier sources
2Sa.date: Final form by the sixth century BC
2Sa.summary: David's reign and the covenant promise to his line.

1Ki.name: 1 Kings
1Ki.author: Anonymous
1Ki.date: Final form by the sixth century BC
1Ki.audience: Israel and Judah through the divided kingdom
1Ki.summary: Solomon, the divided kingdom, and the prophets Elijah and Elisha.

2Ki.name: 2 Kings
2Ki.author: Anonymous
2Ki.date: Final form by the sixth century BC
2Ki.summary: The fall of Samaria and Jerusalem and the road to exile.

1Ch.name: 1 Chronicles
1Ch.author: Anonymous, drawing on earlier records
1Ch.summary: David's reign retold for the returning exiles, with temple worship at the center.

2Ch.name: 2 Chronicles
2Ch.author: Anonymous, drawing on earlier records
2Ch.summary: The temple, the kings of Judah, and the call to return.

Ezr.name: Ezra
Ezr.author: Anonymous, likely a compiler
Ezr.summary: Return from exile, rebuilding the temple, and covenant reform.

Neh.name: Nehemiah
Neh.author: Anonymous, incorporating Nehemiah's memoir
Neh.summary: Rebuilding the walls and renewing the covenant.

Est.name: Esther
Est.author: Anonymous
Est.date: Fourth century BC, set in the Persian court
Est.summary: Deliverance of the Jewish people in Persia.

Job.name: Job
Job.author: Anonymous
Job.date: Composition debated, likely sixth to fourth century BC
Job.summary: Suffering, divine sovereignty, and honest speech before God.

Psa.name: Psalms
Psa.author: David and multiple authors
Psa.date: Collected over centuries, final form by the second century BC
Psa.summary: Praise, lament, thanksgiving, and trust, gathered into five books.

Pro.name: Proverbs
Pro.author: Solomon and other sages
Pro.date: Collected by the sixth century BC
Pro.summary: Skill for living in the fear of the Lord.

Ecc.name: Ecclesiastes
Ecc.author: The Preacher, traditionally identified with Solomon
Ecc.summary: The limits of human striving and the good of receiving life from God.

Sng.name: Song of Songs
Sng.author: Solomon and anonymous editors
Sng.date: Final form by the third century BC

Isa.name: Isaiah
Isa.author: Isaiah and later editors
Isa.date: Eighth century BC through the sixth century BC
Isa.summary: Judgment, comfort, the servant, and restoration.

Jer.name: Jeremiah
Jer.author: Jeremiah with his scribe Baruch
Jer.date: Late seventh and early sixth century BC
Jer.summary: Calls to repent, the fall of Jerusalem, and the new covenant.

Lam.name: Lamentations
Lam.author: Attributed to Jeremiah
Lam.summary: Grief over the fallen city and hope in God's mercies.

Ezk.name: Ezekiel
Ezk.author: Ezekiel
Ezk.summary: God's glory, judgment, restoration, and the renewed temple.

Dan.name: Daniel
Dan.author: Anonymous, presented in Daniel's time
Dan.date: Final form by the second century BC
Dan.summary: God's sovereignty over empires and faithfulness under pressure.

Jol.name: Joel
Jol.author: Joel
Jol.summary: The day of the Lord, repentance, and the outpouring of the Spirit.

Amo.name: Amos
Amo.author: Amos
Amo.summary: Justice, judgment, and the call to seek the Lord.

Oba.name: Obadiah
Oba.author: Obadiah
Oba.summary: Judgment on Edom and the Lord's kingdom.

Mic.name: Micah
Mic.author: Micah
Mic.summary: Judgment, justice, and the promise of a shepherd from Bethlehem.

Nam.name: Nahum
Nam.author: Nahum
Nam.summary: The fall of Nineveh and God's justice.

Hab.name: Habakkuk
Hab.author: Habakkuk
Hab.summary: Honest questions about injustice and the call to live by faith.

Zep.name: Zephaniah
Zep.author: Zephaniah
Zep.summary: The day of the Lord and the promise of a humble remnant.

Hag.name: Haggai
Hag.author: Haggai
Hag.summary: Rebuilding the temple and restored blessing.

Zec.name: Zechariah
Zec.author: Zechariah
Zec.summary: Visions of restoration and the coming king.

Mal.name: Malachi
Mal.author: Anonymous, titled Malachi
Mal.summary: Covenant faithfulness, worship, and the coming messenger.

Mat.name: Matthew
Mat.author: Attributed to Matthew the tax collector
Mat.summary: Jesus as the promised Messiah and teacher of the kingdom.

Mrk.name: Mark
Mrk.author: Attributed to John Mark
Mrk.summary: Jesus as the suffering servant who gives his life as a ransom.

Luk.name: Luke
Luk.author: Luke the physician and companion of Paul
Luk.place: A Greek-speaking city of the empire
Luk.summary: Jesus as Savior for all peoples, attentive to the poor and outcast.

Jhn.name: John
Jhn.author: Attributed to John the apostle
Jhn.summary: Jesus as the eternal Word who gives life and light.

Act.name: Acts
Act.author: Luke
Act.summary: The Spirit's work through the apostles and the spread of the gospel.

Rom.name: Romans
Rom.author: Paul
Rom.summary: The gospel, righteousness by faith, and life in the Spirit.

1Co.name: 1 Corinthians
1Co.author: Paul
1Co.summary: Church order, unity, the gospel, and love.

Gal.name: Galatians
Gal.author: Paul
Gal.summary: Freedom in Christ and the gospel apart from law-keeping.

Eph.name: Ephesians
Eph.author: Paul
Eph.summary: Union with Christ and the unity of the church.

Php.name: Philippians
Php.author: Paul
Php.summary: Joy, humility, and pressing on toward Christ.

Col.name: Colossians
Col.author: Paul
Col.summary: The supremacy of Christ and life rooted in him.

1Th.name: 1 Thessalonians
1Th.author: Paul
1Th.summary: Hope in Christ's return and encouragement under persecution.

2Th.name: 2 Thessalonians
2Th.author: Paul
2Th.summary: Steadiness and clarity about the coming of the Lord.

1Ti.name: 1 Timothy
1Ti.author: Paul
1Ti.audience: Timothy and the church in Ephesus
1Ti.summary: Sound teaching, leadership, and godliness in the household of God.

2Ti.name: 2 Timothy
2Ti.author: Paul
2Ti.summary: Paul's final charge to guard the gospel and finish well.

Tit.name: Titus
Tit.author: Paul
Tit.audience: Titus and the churches on Crete
Tit.summary: Sound doctrine producing good works in community.

Phm.name: Philemon
Phm.author: Paul
Phm.summary: Reconciliation and receiving a brother in Christ.

Heb.name: Hebrews
Heb.author: Anonymous
Heb.summary: Christ as the better priest, sacrifice, and covenant.

Jas.name: James
Jas.author: James the brother of Jesus
Jas.summary: Faith proven by action and care for the vulnerable.

1Pe.name: 1 Peter
1Pe.author: Peter
1Pe.summary: Living hope and holiness under suffering.

2Pe.name: 2 Peter
2Pe.author: Peter
2Pe.summary: Grow in grace and remain steady awaiting the Lord.

1Jn.name: 1 John
1Jn.author: John
1Jn.summary: Assurance, love, and the truth about Christ.

2Jn.name: 2 John
2Jn.author: John
2Jn.audience: A local church and its members
2Jn.summary: Truth and love in the church.

3Jn.name: 3 John
3Jn.author: John
3Jn.summary: Hospitality, support for missionary workers, and church order.

Jud.name: Jude
Jud.author: Jude, brother of James
Jud.summary: Contend for the faith and keep yourselves in God's love.

Rev.name: Revelation
Rev.author: John
Rev.audience: Seven churches of Asia Minor in crisis
Rev.summary: Christ's victory, judgment, and the renewal of all things.
